newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Value City raised on price.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Value City raised on price.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said it upgraded Value City Department Stores Inc to aggressive buy from buy on recent price weakness.
- The stock was up 1/4 to 9. Analyst Jeff Stein said in a report his 12-month target is $13.
- He estimated earnings for the fourth quarter, to be reported the first week in October, at $0.07-$0.08 versus a loss of $0.13 a year ago.
- The company has improved efficiency at its apparel distribution center, revamped advertising, accelerated store expansion and strengthened top management, he said.
